global_automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test case 'Verify the screen, when user click on 'Sign in' link of any cloud accounts under Add accounts in 'Add save' screen.' and any similar cases.
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing this test case or similar cases.
THEN: Always include the following supporting steps:
- Reset the application to a clean state (self.fc.reset_app()) with intermediary: Reset the app to ensure a clean state before test execution.

- Add supported printer on the root view (self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn(), self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)) with intermediary: Click 'Add Device' button on root view, Search for printer by IP address.
- Verify shortcuts screen title (self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()) with intermediary: Verify that the shortcuts screen title is displayed as expected.
- Verify add new shortcut screen title (self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()) with intermediary: Verify that the add new shortcut screen title is displayed as expected.
- Verify add new shortcut title (self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title()) with intermediary: Verify that the add new shortcut title is displayed as expected.
- Click continue on edit shortcut (self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn()) with intermediary: Click the continue button on the edit shortcut screen.
IMPLEMENTATION: These steps must be included in the automation script, in the correct sequence, even if not present in the manual test steps, to ensure the test case purpose is validated.
